  * Only LAMBDA can change agent-loop behavior. SNS/EventBridge notify-only, and their

    {"truncated":true,"preview":...}; "Context truncation does not activate failureMode." ***

  * after_tool_call deny RETAINS the completed tool result.

    de-instrumentation. Max 20 hooks. failureMode allow|deny (deny default).
